extraction.Name: Julia Bourasa Riley
extraction.Refused/Protested: Fee patent issued prior to 1921 without application
extraction.NOTES: Status per Shawnee Indian Agency cover letter: Report mailed to her not returned. Unbundled from Shawnee Indian Agency master list transmitted by Supt. A.W. Leech, March 20, 1929, in response to Circular 2464. Source bundled record: part10_agency_narrative_page035. Document reference: 5-1142. Allotment number not recorded on source list nor in RA spreadsheet. | TASK 5 SHAWNEE FINAL BACKFILL 2026-06-01 (recreated after filter-repo loss): Not found in federal-register-app patents database. May indicate Circular 2464 investigation began but no forced fee patent was consummated, or patent record exists under a different name not currently indexed. Marked as explicitly unresolved per OPERATIONS convention so it is distinguishable from unprocessed rows. Tribe also unknown — every resolvable row on the Shawnee Indian Agency master list turned out to be Citizen Potawatomie, but absent a confirmed database record this row cannot be assigned a definite tribe. | TASK 5 SHAWNEE CORRECTION 2026-06-02: Reverting earlier 'not in patents database' marker — Julia Bourasa Riley IS in the patents database. The 2026-05-04 lookup that documented her as 'not in db' searched the master-list spelling 'Bourasa' (single-s); the database spells the surname 'BOURASSA' (double-s) — same single-s/double-s OCR pattern as Bourbonais/Bourbonnais documented in OPERATIONS. BLM: full record — 1983 Federal Register forced-fee claim case 028 under FedReg name 'JULIA RILEY (BOURASSA)' (GLO patentee 'JULIA BOURASSA'). Forced-fee patent BLM accession 715718, allotment 1121, 80 acres, OK/Pottawatomie county, signed 1919-10-30, Indian Fee Patent. She also held an earlier (non-forced) fee patent: accession 150299, allotment 1117, 320 acres, signed 1910-09-01. Both fee patents converted from her two original 1892 Indian Allotment trust patents: accession 0509-173 (320 acres, → fee 150299) and accession 0509-177 (80 acres, → fee 715718). Allotment field carries 1121 (the Circular 2464-relevant forced-fee allotment); allotment 1117 captured in NOTES.
